# hosttracker_contact (Data Source)

Reads one contact, by id or by a lookup that resolves to exactly one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# By id.
data "hosttracker_contact" "by_id" {
  id = "8e2d4c8b-7a41-4a2b-9d0e-2f3a5c6b7d8e"
}

# By the address it delivers to. The lookup must match exactly one contact.
data "hosttracker_contact" "by_address" {
  lookup_address = "oncall@example.com"
}

# By display name, for a contact created outside Terraform - a messenger
# contact bound by registering with the bot, for instance.
data "hosttracker_contact" "by_name" {
  lookup_name = "Ops Telegram"
}

output "oncall_confirmed" {
  value = data.hosttracker_contact.by_address.confirmed
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The contact's id. Name it, or look the contact up by `lookup_address` or `lookup_name`.
- `lookup_address` (String) Find the contact by the address it delivers to, matched exactly. The lookup must resolve to exactly one contact.
- `lookup_name` (String) Find the contact by its display name, matched exactly. The lookup must resolve to exactly one contact.

### Read-Only

- `active_period` (Attributes) The daily window during which the contact accepts delivery. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--active_period))
- `address` (String) Where notifications are delivered. Absent for a contact that has none, and for a token that may not read it.
- `alert_delay` (Number) How long a failure must persist before this contact hears about it, in minutes.
- `billing_notifications` (Boolean) Whether the account's billing notices go here.
- `bot_id` (String) The bot registration a messenger contact is bound to.
- `confirmed` (Boolean) Whether the recipient has entered the confirmation code. Alerts to an unconfirmed contact are not delivered.
- `created` (Number) When the contact was created, in Unix seconds.
- `gateway` (String) The gateway carrying the message.
- `grouped_alerts` (Boolean) Whether simultaneous alerts are collapsed into one message.
- `http_headers` (Attributes List) The headers a legacy `http` contact sends with each delivery. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--http_headers))
- `language` (String) The language notifications are rendered in.
- `mime_type` (String) The content type a legacy `http` contact is posted with.
- `name` (String) The display name.
- `overlimited` (Boolean) Whether the account's package has stopped this contact from being used.
- `send_cost` (Number) What one notification to this contact costs. Only the paid channels have one.
- `send_news` (Boolean) Whether product news goes here.
- `templates` (Attributes List) The custom per-event bodies the contact posts. Read by the single-contact data source only: a listing does not carry them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--templates))
- `type` (String) How the contact is reached.
- `updated` (Number) The contact's creation instant, in Unix seconds: no edit moves it.

<a id="nestedatt--active_period"></a>
### Nested Schema for `active_period`

Read-Only:

- `days` (Set of String) The weekdays it applies on.
- `end` (String) When it closes.
- `start` (String) When the window opens, as a clock time.
- `timezone` (String) The zone its clock times are read in.


<a id="nestedatt--http_headers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `http_headers`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The header name.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The header value.


<a id="nestedatt--templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `templates`

Read-Only:

- `content` (String) The body.
- `event` (String) Which alert the body renders.
